subject: Copywriting
subcategory: The Science of Storytelling in Ads
title: Before and After Transformation
description: A micro-lesson that makes Before and After Transformation usable.

hook.text: Weight loss ads show a 'before' next to an 'after.' It's the simplest and most effective story structure in advertising.

buildup.text: The before-after arc implies the story without telling it. The audience fills in the struggle, the journey, the triumph.

discovery.text: The gap between before and after IS the product's value proposition. No words needed—the contrast tells the story.

climax.text: Before and After Transformation matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: Before hurts, after heals. The gap sells the product.

quiz.question: What does the gap between before and after represent?
